resources.string: Lipid droplet share of model tissue
White adipocyte share of model tissue
Droplet share of one model cell: %1$s%%

For a spherical droplet and cell, the droplet volume fraction in one cell is r^3, where r is the droplet radius divided by the fixed cell radius. If these cells occupy p percent of the model tissue volume, their droplets occupy p times r^3 percent of that tissue volume.

A mature white adipocyte typically contains one large lipid droplet. This teaching model uses identical spheres with a fixed cell radius and one spherical droplet per cell. The two slider settings are invented ratios, and the rest of the model tissue adds no droplets. This geometry does not estimate personal cell dimensions, body fat mass, obesity status, or metabolic equivalents (METs).
